CORPORATE PROFILE
企業簡介
Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited (the “Group”; SEHK stock code: 1929) was listed on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of
Hong Kong in December 2011. The Group firmly upholds the vision: “To be the leading global jewellery brand that is a trusted lifetime
partner for every generation”, drawing on nearly a century of legacy and success.

Founded in 1929, the Group’s iconic brand “CHOW TAI FOOK” has become an emblem of tradition, celebrated for its bold designs and
an unwavering attention to detail. Building upon a rich heritage and a foundation of trust, the Group is not only widely recognised for
honouring traditions but also for fostering deep, meaningful connections with a diverse customer base through its exquisite jewellery.
The Group’s long-standing commitment to innovation and craftsmanship has been integral to its success over time and has become
synonymous with excellence, value and authenticity.

As a leading Chinese jeweller, the Group believes in blending contemporary cutting-edge designs with traditional techniques to create
jewellery that can be passed down from generation to generation. Every collection is thoughtfully conceived and crafted to reflect the
stories of our customers, celebrating the special moments in their lives. Committed to growing alongside our customers, the Group
embraces a spirit that aspires to inspire and captivate generations to come, weaving the story of CHOW TAI FOOK into the fabric of
their lives.

Offering a wide variety of products, services and channels, the Group’s brand portfolio comprises the CHOW TAI FOOK flagship brand
with curated retail experiences, and other individual brands including HEARTS ON FIRE, ENZO and MONOLOGUE.

The Group is committed to delivering sustainable long-term value creation for its stakeholders by enhancing the quality of earnings and
driving higher value growth. We operate an extensive omni-channel retail ecosystem, with a retail network across China and multiple
locations globally, complemented by a growing e-commerce business that further enhances our competitive edge.




周大福珠寶集團有限公司 (「 集團」；香港聯交所股份代號 ：1929) 於 2011 年 12 月在香港聯合交易所主板上市。集團承襲近百年光輝，
秉持「引領珠寶行業，相伴世代人生」的願景，昂首邁向新里程。


集團標誌性品牌「周大福」創立於 1929 年，透過別出心裁的設計和對細節的堅持，讓傳統成為經典。周大福珠寶集團承載著深厚的歷
史底蕴及堅實的品牌信賴基礎，一直視弘揚傳統文化為己任，並透過匠心打造的精緻飾品，與廣泛的顧客建立深厚的情感聯繫，成就
廣獲認同。集團對創新與工藝的恒久堅持是其取得成功的要素。時至今日，集團已成為了卓越品質、非凡價值和誠信可靠的代名詞。


周大福珠寶集團作為行業領先的中國珠寶商，確信透過現代創新設計揉合傳統工藝，能創造出代代相傳的珠寶首飾。我們每個產品系
列都經過巧妙構思、匠心製作，旨在述說不同顧客的故事，慶祝他們生命中每個特別時刻。我們將陪伴每一代的顧客一同成長，在他
們追尋幸福的道路上提供激勵和啟發，把「周大福」的品牌故事和產品編織到顧客的生活脈絡當中。


集團擁有廣泛的產品、服務及銷售渠道，品牌組合包括旗艦品牌「周大福」及精心策劃的零售體驗，以及 HEARTS ON FIRE、ENZO 與
MONOLOGUE 等其他個性品牌。


集 團 致 力 通 過 提 高 盈 利 質 量 和 推 動 更 高 價 值 的 增 長，為 不 同 持 份 者 創 造 可 持 續 的 長 期 價 值。我 們 構 建 了 龐 大 的 全 渠 道 零 售 生 態 系
統，門店網絡遍布中國和全球多個地區，同時擁有日益增長的電子商務業務，進一步強化競爭優勢。

ANNUAL RESULTS AT A GLANCE
年度業績概覽
KEY HIGHLIGHTS
• Macro-economic externalities and elevated gold prices weighed on the consumer sentiment in FY2025. The Group’s revenue
  decreased by 17.5% year-on-year to HK$89,656 million. Nonetheless, operating profit remained resilient, with a year-on-year growth
  of 9.8%, reaching HK$14,746 million. The operating profit margin expanded by 400 basis points to 16.4%, attributable to an improved
  product mix comprising higher margin products, a higher gold price and our disciplined cost and capital management. The Group’s
  Return on Equity ("ROE") reached 21.9%, which represented a sustained improvement against our 5-year historical average of 18.4%.

• As we continue to progress our five strategic priorities and take a proactive approach to evolving market trends, same store
  performance in Mainland China improved quarter by quarter in FY2025, while that in Hong Kong and Macau was stabilising towards
  the end of the financial year.

• We delivered clear progress on our brand transformation in this financial year, unveiling five new image stores in Mainland China and
  Hong Kong. This premium store format, featuring a rebranded image and redefined retail experience, elevated our brand desirability,
  improved product mix and achieved higher store productivity than the average store during the initial months post opening.

• We continued to optimise product offerings with different value propositions to meet customer preferences and emotional
  resonance. Our fixed-price gold products continued to gain traction with their iconic design and exquisite craftsmanship. Its revenue
  surged by 105.5% year-on-year and its retail sales value mix within the Mainland gold jewellery and product category expanded
  significantly to 19.2% from 7.1% a year ago.

• Our new iconic, fixed-price collections, the CTF Rouge Collection and Chow Tai Fook Palace Museum Collection, have shown
  sustained strong momentum since launch and each achieved sales of approximately HK$4 billion in this financial year, exceeding the
  annual targets. We also undertook select IP collaborations in response to the younger generation’s pursuit of emotional value. This
  initiative cultivates the next generation of gold jewellery customers while enhancing our brand desirability.

• Amidst market uncertainty and volatility, we stay agile while diligently executing our five strategic priorities to sustain business
  resilience and market leadership. Our strategic initiatives have proven effective in improving our store productivity and making a
  positive impact on our financial performance in FY2025.



主要重點
． 2025 財政年度，宏觀經濟外部因素及黃金價格高企影響消費意慾。本集團的營業額按年下跌 17.5% 至 89,656 百萬港元，儘管如此，
  經營溢利維持韌性，同比增長 9.8% 至 14,746 百萬港元。高毛利的產品帶來產品組合的改善，加上黃金價格高企及嚴謹的成本和資
  本管控，經營溢利率擴大 400 個點子至 16.4%。本集團的股本回報率達 21.9%，較過往五年的歷史平均值 18.4% 持續改善。


． 隨著我們持續推進五大策略方針，並積極應對不斷演變的市場趨勢，內地同店表現於 2025 財政年度持續按季改善，而香港及澳門
  的同店表現於本財年末趨向穩定。


． 本財政年度，我們在品牌轉型上取得顯著進展，於內地及香港開設五間新形象店。這款高規格的店型展現煥然一新的品牌形象和
  重新定義的零售體驗，提升了我們的品牌吸引力、改善了產品組合，而且在開業後首幾個月實現了高於一般門店的生產力。


． 我們持續優化產品組合，提供不同定位的產品以滿足顧客群的喜好和達致情感共鳴。我們的定價黃金產品憑藉標誌性的設計和精
  湛工藝，持續深獲顧客青睞，其營業額按年飆升 105.5%。而其在內地的黃金首飾及產品類別中，零售值佔比亦由去年的 7.1% 大幅
  提升至 19.2%。


． 我們全新的標誌性定價產品系列 — 周大福傳福系列及周大福故宮系列，自推出以來一直銷情強勁，本財政年度，兩者的銷售額均
  達到約 40 億港元，超出年度目標。我們亦因應年輕世代對情感價值的追求與精選 IP 聯乘合作，這項舉措不僅有助培育下一代黃金
  首飾消費者，亦提升了品牌吸引力。


． 我們靈活應對市場的不確定性和波動，堅定落實五大策略方針，以保持業務韌性及市場領導地位。我們的策略性舉措有效提升了
  門店生產力，為 2025 財政年度的財務表現帶來積極作用。

Reclassification of gold loan impact                                         黃金借貸影響的重新分類


• We use gold loans (short position in gold) for economic hedging            • 我們利用黃金借貸 ( 黃金淡倉 ) 為經濟避險目的，以減輕
     purposes to mitigate the financial impact of the gold price               黃金存貨 ( 黃金好倉 ) 受黃金價格波動的財務影響。長期
     fluctuations on our gold inventories (long position). Over time,          而 言，預 期 黃 金 好、淡 倉 的 影 響 會 隨 著 出 售 黃 金 存 貨 而
     the long and short positions in gold are expected to offset each          互 相 抵 銷。惟 根 據 會 計 準 則，未 平 倉 的 黃 金 借 貸 合 約 於
     other, through the sales of gold inventories over time. However, in       每個財政報告期末或於合約平倉後需要按市場價格重估，
     accordance with accounting standards, the outstanding gold loan           而 根 據 會 計 準 則，黃 金 存 貨 則 不 予 重 估。此 差 別 導 致 暫
     contracts are revalued at market price at the end of each financial       時的會計收益或虧損。
     reporting period or upon its settlement, while the gold inventories
     are not, in accordance with accounting standards. This disparity
     gives rise to a temporary accounting gain or loss.


• In the past, any gain or loss resulting from revaluation of gold loans     • 以 往，因 重 估 黃 金 借 貸 而 產 生 的 任 何 收 益 或虧損均入賬
     was accounted for in our cost of goods sold (“COGS”), impacting           至我們的「銷售成本」，並對我們所呈報的毛利及經營溢
     our reported gross profit and operating profit. To better reflect         利 帶 來 影 響。為 了 更 妥 善 地 反 映 不 受 對 沖 活動影響下的
     our core underlying operational performance without the impact            核心營運表現，自 2025 財政年度起，我們現將黃金借貸
     of the hedging activities, we are reclassifying gold loan revaluation     重估收益或虧損由「銷售成本」重新分類為「其他收益及
     gain or loss from “COGS” to “other gains and losses” starting from        虧損」。
     FY2025.

• We principally meet our working capital and other liquidity             • 我 們 主 要 透 過 來 自 經 營 現 金 流 量、銀 行 貸 款及黃金借貸
     requirements through a combination of capital contributions,           的 資 本 來 源 應 付 營 運 資 金 及 其 他 流 動 資 金 需求。黃金借
     including cash flows from operations, bank borrowings and gold         貸亦用作經濟避險目的以減輕本集團黃金存貨價格波動
     loans. Gold loans are also used for economic hedge purposes to         的財務影響。
     mitigate the financial impact of price fluctuations in the Group’s
     gold inventories.


• The Group’s daily operation was mainly financed by operating cash       • 本 集 團 日 常 業 務 所 需 資 金 主 要 來 自 經 營 現 金流量，亦會
     flows, and relied on short-term borrowings to satisfy inventory        以 短 期 借 貸 滿 足 旺 季 時 的 存 貨 資 金 需 求、未來擴展計劃
     financing needs during peak seasons, working capital for future        所 需 營 運 資 金 及 預 計 之 外 的 需 求。本 集 團 於償還貸款方
     expansion plans and unexpected needs. The Group has not                面並無任何困難。
     experienced any difficulties in repaying its borrowings.


• The Group’s income and expenditure were mostly denominated              • 本 集 團 之 收 入 及 開 支 主 要 以 港 元 及 人 民 幣 計值，而資產
     in HKD and RMB, while its assets and liabilities were mostly           及 負 債 則 主 要 以 港 元、人 民 幣 及 美 元 計 值。由 於 我 們 中
     denominated in HKD, RMB and USD. No hedging instrument is              國 內 地 日 常 業 務 營 運 的 收 支 大 多 以 人 民 幣 結算，對我們
     deployed against the RMB fluctuation as most of the daily receipts     的 業 務 並 無 構 成 重 大 的 貨 幣 風 險，因 而 未 有針對人民幣
     and payments for our Mainland China operations are both made           波動動用任何對沖工具。
     in RMB, which do not pose a substantive currency exposure to our
     business.


• It is our treasury policy to maintain high liquidity in response to     • 我 們 的 庫 務 政 策 旨 在 保 持 較 高 的 流 動 資 金，以應付營運
     the requirement of operating cash flows; and to maintain financial     現 金 流 量 的 需 求 ；同 時 謹 守 審 慎 的 財 務 政 策，避 免 涉 及

Effect of RMB fluctuation                                                  人民幣波動的影響
• As part of our business operation is in Mainland China, the              • 由 於 我 們 有 部 分 業 務 在 中 國 內 地 經 營，人民幣的波動對
   fluctuation in RMB would have some impact on our performance.             我們的表現構成若干影響。


• Transactions entered by the Hong Kong entities but denominated           • 香港公司以人民幣計值的交易 ( 包括與中國內地附屬公
   in RMB, including the inter-group transactions with the Mainland          司進行的集團間交易 ) 會按交易當天的現貨匯率兌換為
   China subsidiaries, are converted into HKD, the presentation              港 元，即 本 集 團 的 呈 列 貨 幣，而 任 何 未 結 算 的 交 易 則 會
   currency of the Group, initially using the spot rate at the date of       以 收 市 匯 率 於 結 算 日 重 新 換 算。現 貨 匯率與收市匯率的
   transaction and any unsettled transactions are retranslated at the        換 算 差 異 於 損 益 賬 中 確 認，而 人 民 幣 貶值會對我們的年
   closing exchange rate at the balance sheet date. Such translation         內溢利構成負面影響。
   differences between the spot rate and closing exchange rate are
   recognised as profit or loss, negatively affecting our profit for the
   year when RMB depreciated.


• Exchange difference also arises when i) incomes and expenses             • 此外，匯兌差異源於 i) 中國內地分部的收支按平均匯率
   of the Mainland China segment are translated into HKD, the                換 算 為 港 元，即 本 集 團 呈 列 貨 幣，而 相 應 的 資 產 及 負 債
   presentation currency of the Group, at the average exchange rate,         按收市匯率換算 ；及 ii) 中國內地分部的資產淨值於本財
   while the corresponding assets and liabilities are translated at          政年度的收市匯率較上個財政年度的收市匯率有所變動。
   closing exchange rate and ii) the change in closing exchange rates        有關差異於權益中的換算儲備內確認入賬。
   at the current financial year of the net assets of the Mainland
   China segment from the closing rates at the previous financial
   year. Such differences are recognised in the translation reserve in
   equity.

1. BUSINESS OBJECTIVE AND STRATEGY SETTING                                     1. 業務目標和策略制定
Risks are inherent in our business activities and relate to strategic          我 們 的 業 務 活 動 存 在 固 有 風 險，並 與 策 略 性 目 標 和 業 績 有

Main features of the risk identification framework                         風險識別框架的主要特點

 Diversified risk identification   • To ensure the completeness of our risk inventory, we adopted diversified risk identification
 channels                             channels to identify internal, external, emerging, and ESG-related risks that might affect the
 多樣化的風險識別渠道                           achievement of our business objectives and strategies from multiple sources comprehensively
                                      on an ongoing basis
                                      為確保風險清單的完整性，我們採用多樣化的風險識別渠道，持續從多個來源全面識別可能影
                                      響我們達成業務目標與策略的內部、外部、新興及 ESG 相關風險

 Holistic view of risks            • We continuously analyse risk factors relevant to the Group's strategic goals and business value
 風險組合觀                                chain to determine the landscape of significant risks that the Group may face. Risk events
                                      are classified into five major categories, namely Business & Market Development, Branding &
                                      Product, Financial, Supply Chain & Operational Management, and Governance & Compliance,
                                      and are further divided into specific risk items with clear risk descriptions
                                      我們持續分析與集團策略目標及業務價值鏈相關的風險因素，以判斷集團可能面臨的重大風
                                      險景況。風險事件分為五大類，即業務及市場發展、品牌及產品、財務、供應鏈及營運管理，
                                      以及治理及合規，並進一步細分為具體的風險項目，以及明確的風險描述

 Risk inventory management         • We perform periodic reviews to ensure the identified risks are valid and relevant, and to evaluate
 風險清單管理                               any changes to the existing risks
                                      我們定期審閱以確保已識別的風險仍然適用和相關，和評估現有風險的變化

                                      作為定期審閱的一部分，我們會參考內部風險評估、外部稽核、專業審查的結果，以及來自

                                      為確保我們的企業風險管理框架適當地融入不斷變化的風險狀況，我們的風險清單涵蓋可持

Main features of the risk evaluation framework                        風險評估框架的主要特點

 Holistic risk assessment     • The severity of risks is assessed at multiple dimensions and from a holistic perspective by
 全面的風險評估                         risk owners, the Risk Management Department, and senior management team to ensure
                                 comprehensiveness of the risk assessment
                                 風險承擔負責人、風險管理部和高管管理團隊會從多個層面及全面角度檢視風險的嚴重性，
                                 以確保風險評估的全面性


                              • Risk owners are responsible for performing risk assessments of their operational units at least
                                 once a year. Risk Management Department supports risk owners and management in the
                                 process of understanding the key considerations and feasible responses, and groups common
                                 risks across operating units to assess the risk level collectively from the Group’s perspective
                                 風險承擔負責人有責任每年至少一次對其營運單位進行風險評估。風險管理部支援風險承擔
                                 負責人及管理層了解主要考量及可行的對策，並將各營運單位的共通風險歸類，從集團的角
                                 度共同評估風險水平


                              • The final assessment result is depicted in the risk heat map, which is endorsed by senior
                                 management team
                                 最終評估結果將呈現於風險熱點圖，由高管管理團隊認可

 Risk evaluation criteria     • The Group has developed a set of risk evaluation criteria in line with its risk appetite to
 風險評估標準                          comprehensively assess the severity and likelihood of the risks identified
                                 集團對照風險偏好制定了一套風險評估準則，以全面評估風險後果的嚴重性和發生的可能性


                              • The evaluation criteria takes into account the impact of risks in different dimensions, including
                                 brand image and reputation, operational impact, legal and compliance, health and safety, social
                                 responsibility and financial impact, such that both financial and non-financial consequences are
                                 considered in the risk assessments
                                 評估標準考慮風險在不同範疇的影響，包括品牌形象及聲譽、營運影響、法律及合規、健康
                                 與安全、社會責任及財務影響，使評估風險時能考慮到財務及非財務方面的後果


                              • In addition to the established evaluation criteria, the "importance to stakeholders" is considered
                                 to ensure ESG-related concerns are addressed and prioritised during risk assessments. We
                                 engage internal and external stakeholders to identify and evaluate ESG-related risks which may
                                 have significant impacts to the Group and our stakeholders
                                 除了既定的評估準則，我們亦考慮「對持份者的重要性」，以確保 ESG 相關事項在風險評估過
                                 程中會被考量及優先處理。我們邀請內部和外部持份者參與識別和評估可能對集團及持份者
                                 產生重大影響的 ESG 相關風險


                              • The risk assessment results illustrate the risk ratings of all identified risks and provide an
                                 indication of the areas that require management focus and attention
                                 風險評估結果反映所有已識別風險的風險評級，並為管理層指示需要重視和關注的領域

 communications                  when and where possible, to convert data into meaningful risk management information

                                  優質信息及數據分析 – 我們致力於在可行的情況下運用商業智慧及數據分析，將數據轉化為

                                  內部溝通 – 我們採取由上而下和由下而上的方法，確保管理層知悉對集團有影響的風險，以

6. EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS                                                    6. 緊急應變
By nature, most crises are unpredictable, but we believe it is possible      危 機 在 本 質 上 是 無 法 預 測 的，但 我 們 相 信 可 以 辨 識 特 別 容
to determine activities and areas that may be particularly prone to          易 陷 入 危 機 的 活 動 和 領 域。我 們 認 為 針 對 該 等 領 域 作 預 先

                                                      We selected samples of gem-set jewellery products, comprising
                                                      items of different nature, for the gemmological appraisal carried

                                                      Standards disclosure requirements.

2.    SUMMARY OF MATERIAL ACCOUNTING                                         2.   重大會計政策信息概要

3.    CRITICAL ACCOUNTING ESTIMATES                                       3.   主要會計估算
      The preparation of financial statements requires the use of              編製財務報表需作出會計估算，顧名思義，所作會計
      accounting estimates which, by definition, will seldom equal the         估算甚少與有關之實際結果相同。管理層在應用本集
      actual results. Management also needs to exercise judgement              團會計政策時亦需行使判斷力。
      in applying the Group’s accounting policies.


      Estimates are continually evaluated. They are based on                   估算持續評估，並以過往經驗及其他因素 ( 包括可對

      (d)    Disaggregation of revenue                                          (d)   營業額細分

               Accounting Policy                                                      會計政策
               Revenue is measured at the fair value of the                           營業額按本集團一般業務過程中出售商品及
               consideration received or receivable for the sales of                  提供服務的已收或應收代價的公允值計量。
               goods and the provision of services in the ordinary
               course of the Group’s business.


               Revenue is recognised when control over a product                      營業額於產品或服務的控制權轉移或提供給
               or service is transferred or provided to the customer,                 客戶時確認，金額為本集團預期將有權收取之
               at the amount of promised consideration to which                       承諾代價，但不包括代表第三方收取的有關金
               the Group is expected to be entitled, excluding those                  額。營業額不包括增值稅或其他銷售稅，且乃
               amounts collected on behalf of third parties. Revenue                  經扣減任何貿易折扣。
               excludes value added tax or other sales taxes and is
               after deduction of any trade discounts.


               (a)   Sales of goods – Retail                                          (a)   銷售產品 – 零售
                     The Group operates a chain of retail stores                            本集團營運銷售珠寶產品及鐘錶的連鎖
                     selling jewellery products and watches. Revenue                        零售店。銷售商品的營業額在商品於店
                     from the sales of goods is recognised when the                         內轉移予客戶時確認。
                     product is transferred to the customer who takes
                     delivery in store.


                     Payment of the transaction price is due from retail                    應收零售顧客的交易付款即時到期，款
                     customers immediately. The payment is usually                          項通常以現金、信用卡或電子支付結算
                     settled in cash, by credit cards, by means of                          或間接通過零售商場結算。
                     electronic payments or settled indirectly through
                     retail malls.


               (b)   Sales of goods – Customers loyalty                               (b)   銷售產品 – 客戶忠誠度計劃
                     programme
                     Sales of goods that result in award credits for                        根據本集團客戶忠誠度計劃向顧客提供
                     customers, under the Group’s customer loyalty                          獎勵額度之貨品銷售入賬為多元營業額
                     programme, are accounted for as multiple                               交易，且已收或應收代價之公允值於供
                     element revenue transactions and the fair value                        應貨品及所給予獎勵額度之間分配。營
                     of the consideration received or receivable is                         業額不會於最初銷售交易時確認 – 而是
                     allocated between the products supplied and the                        遞延至現金券或積分獲兌換及本集團已
                     award credits granted. Revenue is not recognised                       履行有關責任時方會確認為營業額。
                     at the time of the initial sale transaction – but
                     is deferred and recognised as revenue when the
                     cash coupons or points are redeemed and the
                     Group’s obligations have been fulfilled.

7.    INTEREST INCOME AND FINANCE COSTS                                   7.   利息收入及融資成本

       Accounting Policy                                                       會計政策
       Interest income                                                         利息收入
       Interest income from financial assets at FVPL is included in            來 自 按 公 允 值 計 入 損 益 的 金 融 資 產 的 利息收入計入
       the net fair value gains and losses on these assets.                    該等資產的公允值收益及虧損淨額中。


       Interest income on financial assets at amortised cost                   按 攤 銷 成 本 計 量 的 金 融 資 產 的 利 息 收 入使用實際利
       calculated using the effective interest method is recognised            率法計算，於損益確認為其他收入。
       in the profit or loss as part of other income.

       Interest income is presented as finance income where                    持 作 現 金 管 理 用 途 的 金 融 資 產 賺 取 利 息 收 入 時，利
       it is earned from financial assets that are held for cash               息 收 入 會 呈 列 為 融 資 收 入。任 何 其 他 利 息 收 入 則 計
       management purposes. Any other interest income is included              入其他收入。
       in other income.

       Interest income is calculated by applying the effective interest        利 息 收 入 將 實 際 利 率 應 用 至 金 融 資 產 賬面總值計算
       rate to the gross carrying amount of a financial asset except           得 出，惟 其 後 出 現 信 貸 虧 損 的 金 融 資 產 除 外。就 信
       for financial assets that subsequently become credit-impaired.          貸 減 值 金 融 資 產，實 際 利 率 應 用 於 金 融 資 產 淨 賬 面
       For credit-impaired financial assets the effective interest rate        值 ( 扣除虧損撥備後 )。
       is applied to the net carrying amount of the financial assets
       (after deduction of the loss allowance).


       Borrowing costs                                                         借貸成本
       General and specific borrowing costs that are directly                  直 接 源 自 收 購、建 築 或 生 產 合 資 格 資 產 的 一 般 及 特
       attributable to the acquisition, construction or production of a        定 借 貸 成 本 於 完 成 及 籌 備 資 產 以 作 其 擬定用途或銷
       qualifying asset are capitalised during the period of time that         售 所 需 期 間 內 資 本 化。合 資 格 資 產 指 需 要 大 量 時 間
       is required to complete and prepare the asset for its intended          籌備以作擬定用途或銷售的資產。
       use or sale. Qualifying assets are assets that necessarily take
       a substantial period of time to get ready for their intended
       use or sale.

       Investment income earned on the temporary investment of                 在特定借款撥作合資格資產支出前之暫時投資所
       specific borrowings pending their expenditure on qualifying             賺 取 之 投 資 收 入，須 從 合 資 格 資 本 化 之 借 款 成 本 中
       assets is deducted from the borrowing costs eligible for                扣除。
       capitalisation.

       Other borrowing costs are expensed in the period in which               其他借貸成本於其產生之期間內支銷。
       they are incurred.

14. RIGHT-OF-USE ASSETS AND LEASE                                            14. 使用權資產及租賃負債
    LIABILITIES

        Accounting Policy                                                      會計政策
        Leases are recognised as a right-of-use asset and a                    租 賃 於 租 賃 資 產 可 供 本 集 團 使 用 當 日會確認為使用
        corresponding liability at the date at which the leased asset          權資產及相關負債。
        is available for use by the Group.

        Contracts may contain both lease and non-lease components.             合 約 可 能 包 含 租 賃 及 非 租 賃 成 份。本 集 團 按 照 租 賃
        The Group allocates the consideration in the contract to               及 非 租 賃 成 份 相 應 的 獨 立 價 格，將 合 約 代 價 分 配 至
        the lease and non-lease components based on their relative             租 賃 及 非 租 賃 成 份。然 而，對 本 集 團 為 承 租 人 的 房
        stand-alone prices. However, for leases of real estate for             地 產 租 賃 而 言，其 選 擇 將 租 賃 及 非 租 賃 成 份 視 為 單
        which the Group is a lessee, it has elected not to separate            一租賃成份，並無將兩者區分。
        lease and non-lease components and instead accounts for
        these as a single lease component.

        Assets and liabilities arising from a lease are initially measured     租 賃 產 生 的 資 產 及 負 債 初 始 按 現 值 計 量。租 賃 負 債
        on a present value basis. Lease liabilities include the net            包括下列租賃付款的淨現值 ：
        present value of the following lease payments:

        • fixed payments (including in-substance fixed payments),              • 固定付款 ( 包括實質固定付款 ) 扣減任何應收租
          less any lease incentives receivable;                                  賃優惠 ；


        • variable lease payment that are based on an index or a               • 取決於指數或比率的浮動租賃付款 ( 初始於開始
          rate, initially measured using the index or rate as at the             日期利用指數或比率計量 ) ；
          commencement date;

        • amounts expected to be payable by the Group under                    • 本集團根據餘值擔保預期應付的金額 ；
          residual value guarantees;

        • the exercise price of a purchase option if the Group is              • 在本集團合理確定行使採購選擇權的情況下採購
          reasonably certain to exercise that option; and                        選擇權的行使價 ；及


        • payments of penalties for terminating the lease, if the              • 在租期反映本集團行使該選擇權的情況下，終止
          lease term reflects the Group exercising that option.                  租賃的罰款。


        Lease payments to be made under reasonably certain                     根 據 合 理 確 定 延 續 選 擇 權 支 付 的 租 賃付款亦計入負
        extension options are also included in the measurement of the          債計量之內。
        liability.

        The lease payments are discounted using the interest rate              租 賃 付 款 採 用 租 賃 所 隱 含 的 利 率 予 以 貼 現。倘 無 法
        implicit in the lease. If that rate cannot be readily determined,      釐定該利率 ( 本集團的租賃一般屬此類情況 )，則使
        which is generally the case for leases in the Group, the               用 承 租 人 遞 增 借 貸 利 率，即 個 別 承 租 人 在 類 似 經 濟
        lessee’s incremental borrowing rate is used, being the rate            環 境 中 按 類 似 條 款、抵 押 及 條 件 借 入 獲 得 與 使 用 權
        that the individual lessee would have to pay to borrow the             資產價值類似的資產所需資金必須支付的利率。
        funds necessary to obtain an asset of similar value to the
        right-of-use asset in a similar economic environment with
        similar terms, security and conditions.

       To determine the incremental borrowing rate, the Group:               為釐定遞增借貸利率，本集團 ：


       • where possible, uses recent third-party financing received          • 在可能情況下，使用個別承租人最近獲得的第三
           by the individual lessee as a starting point, adjusted to           方融資為出發點，並作出調整以反映自獲得第三
           reflect changes in financing conditions since third party           方融資以來融資條件的變動 ；
           financing was received;


       • uses a build-up approach that starts with a risk-free               • 對於近期未獲得第三方融資下集團所持有的租
           interest rate adjusted for credit risk for leases held by the       賃，採用以無風險利率為出發點的累加法，並按
           subsidiaries of the Group, which does not have recent third         照租賃的信貸風險作出調整 ；及
           party financing; and


       • makes adjustments specific to the lease, e.g. term, country,        • 進行特定於租約的調整，例如期限、國家、貨幣
           currency and security.                                              及抵押。


       Lease payments are allocated between principal and finance            租 賃 付 款 於 本 金 及 融 資 成 本 之 間 作 出 分 配。融 資 成
       cost. The finance cost is charged to profit or loss over the          本 在 租 賃 期 間 於 損 益 扣 除，藉 以 令 各 期 間 的 負 債 餘
       lease period so as to produce a constant periodic rate of             額的期間利率一致。
       interest on the remaining balance of the liability for each
       period.


       Right-of-use assets are measured at cost comprising the               使用權資產按成本計量，包括以下各項 ：
       following:


       • the amount of the initial measurement of lease liability;           • 初始計量租賃負債的金額 ；


       • any lease payments made at or before the commencement               • 在開始日期或之前作出的任何租賃付款減任何已
           date less any lease incentives received;                            收租賃優惠 ；


       • any initial direct costs; and                                       • 任何初始直接成本 ；及


       • restoration costs.                                                  • 復原成本。


       Right-of-use assets are generally depreciated over the shorter        使 用 權 資 產 一 般 按 直 線 基 礎 以 資 產 可 使用年期或租
       of the asset’s useful life and the lease term on a straight-          期 ( 以較短者為準 ) 計算折舊。倘本集團合理確定行
       line basis. If the Group is reasonably certain to exercise a          使 採 購 選 擇 權，則 使 用 權 資 產 於 相 關 資 產 的 可 使 用
       purchase option, the right-of-use asset is depreciated over           年期內予以折舊。
       the underlying asset’s useful life.

15. INVESTMENT PROPERTIES                                                   15. 投資物業

        Accounting Policy                                                     會計政策
        Investment properties are properties held for long-term rental        投 資 物 業 指 為 長 線 租 金 回 報 持 有 且 不由本集團佔用
        yields and are not occupied by the Group.                             的物業。


        Investment properties are initially measured at cost, including       投資物業初步按成本 ( 包括相關交易成本及借貸成
        related transaction costs and where applicable borrowing              本 ( 如 適 用 )) 計 量。初 始 確 認 後，投 資 物 業 按 成 本
        costs. Subsequent to initial recognition, investment properties       減其後累計折舊及任何累計減值虧損列賬。
        are stated at cost less subsequent accumulated depreciation
        and any accumulated impairment losses.


        If there is a transfer from investment property to owner-             倘 將 投 資 物 業 轉 撥 至 自 用 物 業，以 擁 有 人 開 始 佔 用
        occupied property evidenced by the commencement of                    為 證，則 該 物 業 於 其 後 入 賬 時 按 變 更 用 途 日 期 之 賬
        owner’s occupation, the property shall be measured at its             面值計量。
        carrying amount at the date of change in use for subsequent
        accounting.


        Depreciation is recognised so as to write off the cost of             投 資 物 業 按 估 計 可 使 用 年 期，經 考 慮 其 估 計 剩 餘 價
        investment properties over their estimated useful lives and           值後，樓宇及土地部分按直線基準分別於 20 年或租
        after taking into account their estimated residual value, using       約年期確認折舊，以撇銷投資物業成本。
        the straight-line basis over 20 years for building element or
        lease term for land element.


        An investment property is derecognised upon disposal or               投 資 物 業 於 出 售 後 或 投 資 物 業 永 久 不再使用且預期
        when the investment property is permanently withdrawn                 出 售 不 會 產 生 未 來 經 濟 利 益 時 終 止 確 認。終 止 確 認
        from use and no future economic benefits are expected from            物業產生的任何收益或虧損 ( 按該資產之出售所得
        the disposal. Any gain or loss arising on derecognition of            款項淨額與賬面值之差額計算 ) 於該物業終止確認
        the property (calculated as the difference between the net            期間計入損益。
        disposal proceeds and the carrying amount of the asset) is
        included in profit or loss in the period in which the property is
        derecognised.

21. DEFERRED TAXATION                                                        21. 遞延稅項

        Accounting Policy                                                      會計政策
        Deferred income tax is provided in full, using the liability           遞 延 所 得 稅 採 用 負 債 法 就 資 產 負 債 之稅基與它們在
        method, on temporary differences arising between the tax               綜合財務報表之賬面值兩者之短暫時差作全數撥備。
        bases of assets and liabilities and their carrying amounts in          然 而 如 遞 延 稅 項 負 債 因 初 始 確 認 為 商 譽 而 產 生，則
        the consolidated financial statements. However, deferred               不予以確認。若遞延稅項來自交易 (不包括業務合併)
        tax liabilities are not recognised if they arise from the initial      中 對 資 產 或 負 債 的 初 步 確 認，而 在 交 易 時 不 影 響 會
        recognition of goodwill. Deferred income tax is also not               計 損 益 或 應 課 稅 盈 虧，亦 不 作 記 賬。遞 延 稅 項 採 用
        accounted for if it arises from initial recognition of an asset        在報告期末前已頒佈或實際頒佈之稅率 ( 或法例 ) 釐
        or liability in a transaction other than a business combination        定，並 預 期 在 有 關 之 遞 延 稅 項 資 產 實 現 或 遞 延 稅 項
        that at the time of the transaction affects neither accounting         負債結算時應用。
        nor taxable profit or loss. Deferred income tax is determined
        using tax rates (and laws) that have been enacted or
        substantively enacted by the end of the reporting period and
        are expected to apply when the related deferred income tax
        asset is realised or the deferred income tax liability is settled.


        Deferred tax assets are recognised only if it is probable              遞 延 稅 項 資 產 僅 在 未 來 應 課 稅 金 額 將可用於動用該
        that future taxable amounts will be available to utilise those         等暫時差額及虧損時予以確認。
        temporary differences and losses.


        Deferred tax liabilities and assets are not recognised for             倘 本 公 司 能 控 制 撥 回 暫 時 差 額 的 時 間及該等差異很
        temporary differences between the carrying amount and                  可 能 不 會 於 可 見 將 來 撥 回，則 不 會 就 境 外 業 務 投 資
        tax bases of investments in foreign operations where the               賬 面 值 與 稅 基 之 間 的 暫 時 差 額 確 認 遞延稅項負債及
        company is able to control the timing of the reversal of the           資產。
        temporary differences and it is probable that the differences
        will not reverse in the foreseeable future.


        Deferred tax assets and liabilities are offset where there is          當有可依法強制執行的權利將即期稅項資產與負
        a legally enforceable right to offset current tax assets and           債 抵 銷，而 遞 延 稅 項 結 餘 與 同 一 稅 務 機 構 相 關 時，
        liabilities and where the deferred tax balances relate to the          則 可 將 遞 延 稅 項 資 產 與 負 債 抵 銷。當 實 體 有 可 依 法
        same taxation authority. Current tax assets and tax liabilities        強 制 執 行 抵 銷 權 利 且 有 意 按 淨 額 基 準結算或同時變
        are offset where the entity has a legally enforceable right to         現 資 產 及 清 償 負 債 時，則 即 期 稅 項 資 產 與 稅 項 負 債
        offset and intends either to settle on a net basis, or to realise      抵銷。
        the asset and settle the liability simultaneously.


        Current and deferred tax is recognised in profit or loss,              即 期 及 遞 延 稅 項 將 於 損 益 中 確 認，惟 與 該 稅 項 有 關

       Accounting Policy                                                    會計政策
       Inventories are stated at the lower of cost and net realisable       存 貨 以 成 本 及 可 變 現 淨 值 兩 者 中 的 較 低 者 入 賬。成
       value. Cost comprises direct materials, direct labour and            本 包 括 直 接 原 料、直 接 勞 工 及 適 當 比 例 的 浮 動 及 固
       an appropriate proportion of variable and fixed overhead             定間接開銷 ( 後者即按正常營運能力分配 )。就珠寶
       expenditure, the latter being allocated on the basis of              鑲 嵌 首 飾、鉑 金 及 K 金 首 飾 ( 製 成 品 )、按 固 定 價 格
       normal operating capacity. Cost is calculated using specific         出 售 的 黃 金 首 飾 及 產 品 及 鐘 錶 而 言，成 本 採 用 特 定
       identification basis for gem-set jewellery, platinum and k-gold      識別基準計算，而其他存貨則利用加權平均法計算。
       jewellery (finished goods), gold jewellery and products selling      購 買 存 貨 之 成 本 經 扣 除 回 扣 及 折 扣 後 釐 定。可 變 現
       at fixed price and watches; and weighted average for other           淨 值 按 一 般 業 務 過 程 中 估 計 的 銷 售 價 格減去所有尚
       inventories. Costs of purchased inventory are determined             需投入的估計完成成本及估計銷售費用計算。
       after deducting rebates and discounts. Net realisable value is

31. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                                 31. 資本風險管理
      The Group manages its capital to ensure that the group entities         本集團管理資本旨在確保集團實體可持續經營，並透
      will be able to continue as a going concern while maximising            過維持債務與權益的最佳平衡而為股東提供最大回報。
      the return to shareholders through the optimisation of the debt
      and equity balance.


      The capital structure of the Group consists of bank borrowings,         本集團的資本架構包括銀行貸款、黃金借貸和本公司
      gold loans and equity attributable to shareholders of the               股東應佔股權 ( 包括綜合財務報表所披露之股本、儲
      Company, comprising share capital, reserves and retained                備及保留溢利 )。
      profits as disclosed in the consolidated financial statements.


      The management of the Group reviews the capital structure               本集團管理層定期檢討資本架構。本集團會考慮資本
      regularly. The Group considers the cost of capital and the              成本及各類資本相關的風險，亦透過派付股息、發行
      risks associated with each class of capital, and will balance           新股、籌集銀行貸款及黃金借貸平衡本集團整體資本
      its overall capital structure through the payment of dividends,         架構。
      new share issues as well as the raising of bank borrowings
      and gold loans.

       Accounting Policy                                                    會計政策
       Post-employment obligations                                          僱員離職後責任
       The Group operates various post-employment schemes,                  本 集 團 營 運 多 個 僱 員 離 職 後 計 劃，包 括 定 額 福 利 及
       including both defined benefit and defined contribution              定額供款退休計劃。
       pension plans.

       The liability or asset recognised in the consolidated statement      於 綜 合 財 務 狀 況 表 就 定 額 福 利 退 休 金 計劃確認的負
       of financial position in respect of defined benefit pension          債 或 資 產 乃 定 額 福 利 責 任 於 報 告 期 結 算日的現值減
       plans is the present value of the defined benefit obligation         計 劃 資 產 的 公 允 值。定 額 福 利 責 任 每 年 由 獨 立 精 算
       at the end of the reporting period less the fair value of plan       師利用預測單位貸記法計算。
       assets. The defined benefit obligation is calculated annually by
       independent actuaries using the projected unit credit method.

       The present value of the defined benefit obligation is               定 額 福 利 責 任 的 現 值 利 用 以 支 付 福 利 的 貨 幣 計 值、
       determined by discounting the estimated future cash outflows         到 期 情 況 與 相 關 責 任 年 期 相 若 的 優 質 公司債券的利
       using interest rates of high-quality corporate bonds that are        率，將 估 計 未 來 現 金 流 出 貼 現 而 釐 定。就 債 券 並 無
       denominated in the currency in which the benefits will be paid,      深入市場的國家而言，則利用政府債券的市場利率。
       and that have terms approximating the terms of the related
       obligation. In countries where there is no deep market in such
       bonds, the market rates on government bonds are used.

       Service cost and net interest cost on the net defined benefit        定 額 福 利 負 債 淨 額 的 服 務 成 本 及 利 息 成本淨額於損
       liability are recognised in profit or loss and allocated by          益內確認，且按功能分配入「銷售及分銷成本」或「一
       function as part of “selling and distribution costs” or “general     般 及 行 政 開 支」之 一 部 分。即 期 服 務 成 本 按 僱 員 於
       and administrative expenses”. Current service cost is                本 期 提 供 服 務 產 生 定 額 福 利 責 任 之 現 值 增 幅 計 算。
       measured as the increase in the present value of the defined         利 息 成 本 淨 額 透 過 將 貼 現 率 應 用 於 定 額福利責任結
       benefit obligation resulting from employee service in the            餘淨額及計劃資產公允值計算。
       current period. The net interest cost is calculated by applying
       the discount rate to the net balance of the defined benefit
       obligation and the fair value of plan assets.

       Remeasurement gains and losses arising from experience               經 驗 調 整 及 精 算 假 設 變 動 產 生 的 損 益 重新計量於產
       adjustments and changes in actuarial assumptions are                 生 期 間 直 接 於 其 他 全 面 收 益 內 確 認。有 關 損 益 計 入
       recognised in the period in which they occur, directly in other      綜合權益變動表及綜合財務狀況表的保留盈利。
       comprehensive income. They are included in retained earnings
       in the consolidated statement of changes in equity and in the
       consolidated statement of financial position.

       Changes in the present value of the defined benefit                  計 劃 修 訂 或 削 減 產 生 定 額 福 利 責 任 現 值變動即時於
       obligation resulting from plan amendments or curtailments are        損益內確認為過往服務成本。
       recognised immediately in profit or loss as past service costs.

       For defined contribution plans, the Group pays contributions         就 定 額 供 款 計 劃 而 言，本 集 團 按 強 制、合 約 或 自 願
       to publicly or privately administered pension insurance plans        基 準 向 公 眾 或 私 人 管 理 退 休 金 保 險 計 劃 支 付 供 款。
       on a mandatory, contractual or voluntary basis. The Group has        本 集 團 於 支 付 供 款 後 再 無 額 外 付 款 責 任。供 款 於 到
       no further payment obligations once the contributions have           期 時 確 認 為 僱 員 福 利 開 支。預 付 供 款 於 具 有 現 金 退
       been paid. The contributions are recognised as employee              款或可供扣減未來付款時確認為資產。
       benefit expense when they are due. Prepaid contributions are
       recognised as an asset to the extent that a cash refund or a
       reduction in the future payments is available.
